newsitem.title: USA: Horizon shrholders to vote on share issue.
newsitem.headline: Horizon shrholders to vote on share issue.

text.p: Horizon Mental Health Management Inc said Friday it would hold a special shareholders meeting August 11 to vote on the company's issuing 1.4 million shares to pay for a recent acquisition.

Horizon said it would issue the stock, which represents about 17.4 percent of its outstanding stock on a fully-diluted basis, to buy privately-held Specialty Healthcare Management Inc of Englewood, Colo.

The company first announced the acquisition April 28, when it said it would buy Specialty for 1.65 million shares. Based on Horizon's April 28 closing price of 15-3/8, the transaction valued Specialty at $25.4 million.

Horizon on July 2 changed the acquisition agreement July 2, saying it would pay 1.4 million shares for Specialty instead of 1.65 million shares. The company's shares traded at 24-7/8 Friday afternoon, down 1-1/8. Based on this price, Horizon is paying about $35 million for Specialty.
